info.name: Attendance System API (ProjectC)
info.description:
Import: Postman → Import → Raw text (paste file contents) or File.
Set collection variables: `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080), `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `publicFeedbackToken`, `siteId`, `userId`, `attendanceId`.
Auth: most requests need `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` (saved on folder).
Binary responses: GET /api/files, POST /api/public/feedback/{token}/approve (PDF).
